name: BI Readiness Verification
description: Observe an existing semantic model's schema, opt-in data counts, an explicitly correlated refresh and report binding with a total deadline. Preserves native/generated/authored mode and never resubmits work or rebinds.
prerequisites: Existing model and report with explicit IDs, and a known model table name.

Select REFRESH_ID from refresh's submission or generate's framing receipt only when correlationStatus is verified. If no verified identity is available, compare history against a pre-submission baseline where possible; never choose an older success or resubmit ambiguously accepted work.
The opt-in COUNTROWS data check may scan data and consume capacity; it runs under the current identity only.

variables.REPORT: Existing report UUID in the same workspace; add --report-workspace for another report workspace.
variables.REFRESH_ID: Explicit correlated refresh request UUID, not latest history.

steps.description: Preview validated read scope. No network calls, data query, refresh or rebind occurs in dry-run.

Verify all selected observations under one deadline. Review checks and notChecked even when ready; zero rows fail this minimum but do not prove source absence. Stop on failed selected refresh or bounds; no automatic mutations.

limitations: Schema and query readiness do not establish Delta schema/protocol compatibility or freshness, storage/fallback mode or viewer/source grants.
Binding does not author or render report visuals. Keep source validation and report authoring as separate explicitly chosen workflows.
